layout: 2 columns x 2 rows: hover, alert, attack, recovery

assets.name: 蜂群无人机
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent 2.5D aerial enemy animation sprite sheet for a side-scrolling armored stickman shooter.
Input image: the attached enemy atlas is a STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE only, not an edit target. Create only the single aircraft specified below, with its own stronger silhouette. Match its premium sculpted hand-painted game render, brushed charcoal metal, beveled armor, glowing colored sensors and clean readable rim light.
Canvas: square transparent PNG, exactly TWO COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, four equal isolated cells. No grid lines or labels. Each cell contains the SAME aircraft in a different mechanical configuration. ALL four face strictly LEFT in a consistent three-quarter SIDE view, nose horizontal and level; do not rotate whole aircraft into a diagonal dive because the game applies trajectory rotation. Identical model scale and center in all cells. Every complete aircraft including wings and glows must fit within central 70 percent of its cell. At least 15 percent transparent margin on every edge. Never overlap cells. Show complete vehicle and equipment, no cropped weapons or wings. Transparent alpha everywhere outside aircraft. No floor, shadows cast onto ground, background, text, logos, detached projectiles or external effects. Keep engine glow tight to vents; no long painted exhaust trails, rotor motion blur or huge halos. Draw crisp rotor mechanisms (runtime supplies spinning effects). A consistent softly lit dimensional 2.5D game illustration, NOT a flat vector icon, NOT a human-shaped robot.
Four poses read left-to-right, top-to-bottom: hover; alert/preparation; attack; recovery. Actually hinge wings, extend guns, open armor panels or tilt vanes as described. Maintain same mass, colors and component identity across all frames.
Aircraft design: A tiny lethal bee-shaped interceptor drone: compact hexagonal graphite body, amber gold edge armor, one large amber sensor eye in a pointed LEFT nose, two small dorsal ducted micro-rotors, short swept insect winglets, rear needle stabilizer. Very lightweight, compact triangular insect silhouette, NO animal anatomy. GOLD/AMBER and charcoal. Easy to read even at 30 pixels wide.
Mechanical pose details: hover: twin winglets spread and sensor amber; alert: winglets hinge up, armored needle nose extends; attack: winglets folded backward, compact dart silhouette and rear engine lit amber; recovery: winglets flared wide, braking fins deployed.
